+/// Repair composes merged sub results; a refused roll-up means some subs never
+/// merged, so repair has nothing to compose and must refuse with the resume
+/// path instead of re-stating the roll-up error.
+pub(crate) fn campaign_repair_unmerged_refusal(
+    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
+    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
+    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
+) -> Option<VerdictSurface> {
+    if rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
+        return None;
+    }
+    let resumes = refused_sub_resume_commands(paths, campaign, rollup);
+    let primary = resumes.first().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
+        format!(
+            "deadreckon show {} --why-failed",
+            run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id)
+        )
+    });
+    Some(campaign_repair_refusal_surface(
+        campaign,
+        VerdictKind::Blocked,
+        format!(
+            "DeadReckon cannot repair this campaign because {} never merged.",
+            rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")
+        ),
+        "Repair composes merged sub results, and an unmerged sub has nothing to compose. Resume the interrupted children so their plans can complete, then re-run the campaign.",
+        primary,
+    ))
 }

+#[test]
+fn refused_campaign_recommends_resuming_interrupted_children_not_repair() {
+    let (temp, paths) = temp_paths();
+    let run_id = failed_child_run(&temp, &paths, QUOTA_REASON);
+    let (campaign, rollup) = refused_campaign_fixture(&paths, &run_id);
+
+    let surface =
+        commands::campaign::campaign_verdict_surface(Some(&paths), &campaign, Some(&rollup));
+    let child = run_prefix(&run_id);
+    assert_eq!(
+        surface.primary_action.command,
+        format!("deadreckon resume {child}"),
+        "a refused roll-up means unmerged subs, which repair cannot compose"
+    );
+    let rendered = surface.render_plain(false);
+    assert!(
+        !rendered.contains("campaign repair"),
+        "repair is guaranteed to refuse here and must not be recommended: {rendered}"
+    );
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn repair_refusal_for_unmerged_subs_names_resume_path() {
+    let (temp, paths) = temp_paths();
+    let run_id = failed_child_run(&temp, &paths, QUOTA_REASON);
+    let (campaign, rollup) = refused_campaign_fixture(&paths, &run_id);
+
+    let surface = commands::campaign::campaign_repair_unmerged_refusal(&paths, &campaign, &rollup)
+        .expect("unmerged subs must refuse repair with the resume path");
+    let rendered = surface.render_plain(false);
+    assert!(rendered.contains("never merged"), "{rendered}");
+    assert!(
+        rendered.contains(&format!("deadreckon resume {}", run_prefix(&run_id))),
+        "{rendered}"
+    );
+}
+
+fn refused_campaign_fixture(
+    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
+    child_run_id: &str,
+) -> (
+    deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
+    deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
+) {
+    let plan = plan_with_failed_child(Some(child_run_id.to_string()));
+    save_plan(paths, &plan).expect("save plan");
+    let subs = build_sub_goals(
+        vec!["rebuild billing".to_string(), "rebuild docs".to_string()],
+        2,
+    )
+    .expect("subs");
+    let mut campaign = Campaign::new(
+        "rebuild everything",
+        subs,
+        PlanProviders::default(),
+        0,
+        Some(10.0),
+        None,
+        "0.1.0",
+    )
+    .expect("campaign");
+    campaign.status = deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignStatus::Failed;
+    let launch_dir = paths
+        .home()
+        .join("plans")
+        .join(&campaign.campaign_id)
+        .join("launch")
+        .join(&campaign.sub_goals[0].sub_id);
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir).expect("launch dir");

976	    let id = run_prefix(&campaign.campaign_id);

984	    // repair is guaranteed to refuse there.

988	        (Some(paths), Some(rollup)) if campaign.status == CampaignStatus::Failed => {
989	            refused_sub_resume_commands(paths, campaign, rollup)

991	        _ => Vec::new(),
992	    };
993	    let (kind, what, why) = match campaign.status {
994	        CampaignStatus::Merged => (
995	            VerdictKind::Completed,
996	            "The campaign assembled its sub-orchestrator results into one result run.",
997	            "DeadReckon has a campaign artifact; the recommended command lands or inspects that result.",
998	        ),
999	        CampaignStatus::Failed if !resume_commands.is_empty() => (
1000	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
1001	            "The campaign stopped because interrupted sub-orchestrator children never completed.",
1002	            "Each refused sub traces to a child run that was interrupted; resuming those children lets their plans finish so the campaign can roll up.",
1003	        ),
1004	        CampaignStatus::Failed if repairable => (
1005	            VerdictKind::Blocked,
1006	            "The campaign stopped after merged sub results produced a caveat roll-up.",
1007	            "This is a deterministic campaign-level refusal, not a provider crash; repair can inspect the sub-results and produce a consolidated artifact.",
1008	        ),
1009	        CampaignStatus::Failed => (
1010	            VerdictKind::Failed,
1011	            "The campaign stopped before producing a merged result.",
1012	            "No resumable child or repairable roll-up evidence resolved, so failure inspection is the safest next command.",
1013	        ),
1014	        CampaignStatus::Killed => (
1015	            VerdictKind::Killed,
1016	            "The campaign was stopped before all sub-orchestrators could finish.",
1017	            "Killed campaign state should be inspected before cleanup or relaunch.",
1018	        ),
1019	        CampaignStatus::Forked => (
1020	            VerdictKind::Paused,
1021	            "The campaign has launched sub-orchestrators and is not merged yet.",
1022	            "Attach is the safest next command because sub-plan state may still be active.",
1023	        ),
1024	        CampaignStatus::Pending => (
1025	            VerdictKind::Preview,
1026	            "The campaign record exists, but no sub-orchestrator has started yet.",
1027	            "Attaching or launching the stored campaign state is the next non-destructive step.",
1028	        ),
1029	    };
1030	    let primary = resume_commands
1031	        .first()
1032	        .cloned()
1033	        .unwrap_or_else(|| campaign_primary_action(campaign, repairable));
1034	    let mut evidence = vec![
1035	        ("campaign".to_string(), id.clone()),
1036	        (
1037	            "status".to_string(),
1038	            campaign_status_text(campaign.status).to_string(),
1039	        ),
1040	        (
1041	            "subs".to_string(),
1042	            format!("{merged_subs}/{} merged", campaign.n),
1043	        ),
1044	    ];
1045	    if let Some(result_run_id) = campaign.merged_run_id.as_deref() {
1046	        evidence.push(("result run".to_string(), run_prefix(result_run_id)));
1047	    }
1048	    if let Some(rollup) = rollup {
1049	        evidence.push((
1050	            "roll-up".to_string(),
1051	            rollup_verdict_text(rollup.rollup_verdict).to_string(),
1052	        ));
1053	        if !rollup.refused_subs.is_empty() {
1054	            evidence.push(("refused subs".to_string(), rollup.refused_subs.join(", ")));

1089	        secondary
1090	            .iter()
1091	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str())),
1092	    )
1093	}

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-06-11 17:29:02Z)**_

After reading all three changed files in full and tracing the data flow:

**Summary of the change:** A local CLI tool ("deadreckon") refactors how campaign-repair failure surfaces are constructed. The new code:
1. Splits `sub_failure_summary` into a typed `sub_failure_details` helper (no logic change in what it reads).
2. Adds `refused_sub_resume_commands` which builds advisory `deadreckon resume <prefix>` strings.
3. Adds `campaign_repair_unmerged_refusal` short-circuiting `campaign_repair_command` earlier with a refusal surface when `rollup.refused_subs` is non-empty.
4. Tests covering these paths.

**Sinks examined:**
- No shell/exec/subprocess: the `deadreckon …` strings are rendered into a `VerdictSurface` and printed for the operator to read; they are not executed.
- No SQL, eval, deserialization, network, template, or IAM sinks reached.
- File reads are pre-existing (`load_plan`, `read_sub_result`, `child_failure_reason`) and trust the same locally-owned `~/.deadreckon` state they already trusted; no new path joins of attacker-influenced data introduced.
- The new short-circuit in `campaign_repair_command` is fail-closed: it only adds an *additional* early refusal when `refused_subs` is non-empty; the downstream `repair_and_promote_campaign_result` still has its own `campaign_can_complete` gate that handled this case before. No prior security check is bypassed or weakened.
- The new "Failed if !resume_commands.is_empty()" arm in `campaign_verdict_surface` and the `repairable = Caveat` narrowing are pure messaging changes; nothing executes based on them.
- `paths == None` path in `campaign_verdict_surface` simply yields an empty `resume_commands` vector and falls through to the existing branches — no fail-open.

No source→sink path with attacker influence and no missing/inverted check was identified in the diff.
